text:
Just landed at New Chitose Airport?
The train to Sapporo takes 33 minutes,
and Suica just works.
But sometimes the bus is the smarter ride 👇

🤔 Full guide 👉 https://japanbystation.com/new-chitose-airport-to-sapporo

🚆 Option A: JR Rapid Airport train
Six trains an hour in the daytime.
33 to 43 minutes, depending on the train.
💴 ¥1,230, no booking needed.
💺 Car 4 has reserved u-seats, ¥1,000 extra
(¥800 if you book online).

🚌 Option B: the airport bus
💴 ¥1,500 to Sapporo Station or Susukino.
🏨 It also stops at some big hotels,
like Keio Plaza Hotel Sapporo
and Grand Mercure Sapporo Odori Koen.
Pay when you get off. No Suica.

🚗 Option C: taxi or rental car
A taxi takes about 60 minutes
and costs from about ¥17,000.
Rent a car only if you're driving
on into the countryside.

💭 Our take
Take the train,
unless your hotel is a bus stop.
Then the bus drops you at the door.

❄️ Heavy snow can stop trains.
In January 2026, JR Hokkaido cancelled
1,145 trains in two days.
